mapper.select: select exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.data_scope = '1' and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' )

select distinct l.id from lab_laboratory l where l.del_flag = '0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id inner join sys_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0' and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' and ( r.data_scope = '1' or (r.data_scope = '2' and exists ( select 1 from sys_role_dept rd where rd.role_id = r.role_id and rd.dept_id = l.dept_id )) or (r.data_scope = '3' and l.dept_id = u.dept_id) or (r.data_scope = '4' and exists ( select 1 from sys_dept scoped_dept where scoped_dept.dept_id = l.dept_id and scoped_dept.status = '0' and scoped_dept.del_flag = '0' and (scoped_dept.dept_id = u.dept_id or find_in_set(u.dept_id, scoped_dept.ancestors) > 0) )) or (r.data_scope = '5' and l.manager_id = #{userId}) ) ) order by l.id
